findings.note: Reviewed the full tier-2 settled turn-3 precombat-main premise: empty stack/hands/libraries/graveyards, four untapped permanents under their owners, A priority, life20 and no mana; ordinary control history, no previous action or continuous effect. Sparse/default characteristics are the pinned Forest and Orochi Leafcaller characteristics. Initiative/day-night/designations/flipped/phased-out/in-combat are absent and remain at defaults. This is an unfinished scenario, not a completed game.
Forest intrinsic {T}:Add{G} taps forestA and immediately adds one green; A receives priority afterward and its implied pass gives B priority. No stack object, damage or other characteristic change.
B taps forestB for green; mana resolves immediately. Its implied pass gives A priority, without emptying either pool or ending the main phase because B activated between passes.

Leafcaller paragraph1 is {G}:Add one mana of any color. A explicitly spends its one green and chooses green, leaving one green. No tap cost and no stack entry. Activation resets the consecutive-pass sequence; all other facts remain unchanged.

After callerA, A then B pass on the empty stack. The main phase ends, both one-green pools empty, and turn3 beginning-of-combat starts with A priority. Both Forests stay tapped, both Leafcallers stay untapped, life remains20, no objects move, and result remains unfinished. This accounts for the complete final delta.
